# ThreadGrab

> Free online tool to save public X (Twitter) threads, Bluesky posts, and LinkedIn articles as clean text or Markdown for offline reading. No install, no account, no watermark.

## Main pages

- [Home (English)](https://threadgrab.com/en/): Save X threads and articles as clean text in one click.
- [Home (Bahasa Indonesia)](https://threadgrab.com/id/): ThreadGrab versi Bahasa Indonesia.
- [Home (Português)](https://threadgrab.com/pt/): ThreadGrab em português.

## What ThreadGrab does

- Fetches public X (Twitter) threads, articles, and posts as readable plain text or Markdown.
- Fetches public Bluesky posts via the AT Protocol's open API.
- Works in any browser, no install or account required.
- Free to use, with no watermark, rate-limit, or sign-up wall.

## What ThreadGrab does not do

- Does not fetch private / friends-only posts.
- Does not log user download history beyond standard 7-day server logs.
- Does not republish, redistribute, or commercialize fetched content.
- Is not affiliated with X Corp., Bluesky Social PBC, or LinkedIn / Microsoft.
